## Specification Analysis Report

Fresh read-only analysis of the current post-waterfall Feature 802 artifacts. Prerequisite command succeeded; spec.md, plan.md and complete tasks.md are present. Valid extension YAML registers no before_analyze or after_analyze hooks. Constitution and all five design artifacts were read. No product artifact was changed.

| ID | Category | Severity | Location(s) | Summary | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| I-802-TASK-INTRO | Inconsistency | LOW | specs/802-normalize-text/tasks.md:3; T002–T012 | Introductory text says all new tasks are unchecked; the current task entries are checked. This is stale task-generation prose, not missing implementation work. | At a separately authorized documentation correction, describe the introductory statement as generation history or remove it; preserve actual task states. |

No material requirements, design, constitution, dependency, or task-eligibility gap was found. The restored FR-008 at spec.md:70 requires exit status 2, stderr diagnostic and zero stdout, agreeing with its accepted answer, US2 independent test, plan coverage, research, data-model rejection status, CLI contract, T003, T008 and T010. Historical synthetic sources deliberately leave decisions open; spec.md:59 and :91 explicitly identify accepted operator answers as this feature's resolution. They do not create an unresolved product decision in this analysis.

### Coverage Summary

Coverage below is a semantic mapping from task descriptions, not proof that checked tasks implement their requirements.

| Requirement Key | Has Task? | Task IDs | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Yes | T003,T005,T007,T009,T010 | Single path, argument validation, no stdin |
| FR-002 | Yes | T003,T004,T007,T008,T010 | Strict UTF-8; character preservation; decode before emit |
| FR-003 | Yes | T004,T006 | ASCII space/tab only |
| FR-004 | Yes | T004,T006 | Interior whitespace and trailing blank lines |
| FR-005 | Yes | T004,T006 | CRLF then CR conversion |
| FR-006 | Yes | T004,T006 | Original emptiness; conditional final LF |
| FR-007 | Yes | T005,T007,T011 | stdout only; input immutability |
| FR-008 | Yes | T003,T008,T010,T011 | Exit 2, diagnostics, zero stdout |
| FR-009 | Yes | T005,T007,T011,T012 | No product cap; full-buffering limitation documented |
| SC-001 | Yes | T004,T005,T011 | Exact output comparison |
| SC-002 | Yes | T008,T009,T011 | Exact status and channels |
| SC-003 | Yes | T004,T005,T011 | Determinism and idempotence |

### Constitution Alignment

No conflicts found: standard library only, local deterministic CLI, accepted human choices preserved, unit and subprocess tests explicitly tasked. No integration, publication or acceptance is inferred. All 12 tasks map to requirements or supporting design/setup/validation: T001 contract history; T002 setup; T003 foundation; T004–T010 stories; T011–T012 validation/documentation. No unmapped tasks or ordering contradiction. Separate test files support the marked parallel steps; shared module edits are sequential. Full buffering is a disclosed environmental limitation, not an unsupported numeric performance promise.

### Metrics

12 analyzed requirements/outcomes (9 FR, 3 build-verifiable SC); 12 tasks, all checked; coverage 100%; ambiguity count 0; duplication count 0; critical 0; high 0; medium 0; low 1. Unchecked eligible implementation tasks: 0. No prerequisite errors.

### Next Actions

Return this fresh report to the declared eligibility assessment. No implementation command or artifact correction is authorized by this read-only analysis. The low task-introduction wording issue does not establish unbuilt product work. No corrective workflow is invoked, and no feature or roadmap acceptance is claimed. Optional concrete remediation would remove or historicize the stale introductory sentence without altering task checkboxes; it requires the existing workflow correction authority.
